gate: missed must not INCREASE. Not a percentage floor -- see #308 and #321.
how_it_was_measured: The root lines-covered/lines-valid attributes of the backend-coverage artifact from six consecutive successful `main` CI runs (34447917136, 34449722396, 34710928493, 34715324929, 34721501302, 34722073332), every one of them bit-identical at covered=5403 / valid=5585, and reproduced locally on a clean worktree with no backend/.env via `make coverage` at the SHA above. `lines-valid` drifts as app/ grows (5562 -> 5567 -> 5585 across the runs before those), which is why the gate is the integer count and not the percentage.
how_to_change_it: Lowering it locks in an improvement and needs no justification. RAISING it means shipping lines no test executes: do it in the same commit as the code, and say in the commit message which lines and why they are not testable here.
